PERSIST START run_id=20261021T092330Z source=/tmp/rocket2-paper-20261021T092330Z archive=/home/user/solana_sniper/runs/rocket2-paper-20261021T092330Z


================ FILE: README.md ================
Rocket2 paper run archive

Profile: 3 concurrent slots. Wallet sizes each entry at one-third of currently
available cash (wallet.py PARTS=3), capped at 1500 RUB per entry.

Retention: each run receives a unique directory under runs/; the runner does not
apply automatic deletion or rotation. While a run is active, persist_run.py mirrors
console.log and readable state into this archive and writes consistent SQLite
snapshots (about every 15 seconds). The runner performs a final copy at shutdown.

Dashboard: /download/all.txt downloads the live/current run as one UTF-8 text file.
It contains a JSON status snapshot, manifest and logs, plus SQLite rows rendered
as JSONL by table. The original SQLite databases are retained alongside this file.

Execution policy: paper-only. No signed or submitted transactions.
